basis: LGLN NaVKV 2/3 2010, PDF p.33/printed p.32 fig.4 reproduces the 1985 DDR map of the Wolfenbuettel/Hornburg boundary. PDF pp.40-42 describe the post-1941 territorial allocation, joint 1974-1976 survey and 1986 inspection of section 21. The adopted window is restricted to the Hornburg/Grosses Bruch line visible in this period map, including the former west-side bend; it does not extend to all Harz or Altmark. NLWKN independently describes Grosses Bruch on the current Niedersachsen/Sachsen-Anhalt boundary. Reuse pinned VG25 only between actual intersections. Documentary continuity and visual period-map review; no independent historical-vector 0.5px pass.
